blocks.content: Course: Build your First Web App with React
Just now, you added more JSX code to render the entry card. The structure is simple:

items: The outer <div> wraps everything (remember: JSX needs one root element).
Inside, you have the <header> and its contents from before.
Below the header, another <div> represents one journal entry.

blocks.content: This is all static right now. The text is hardcoded directly in JSX. That's fine for now; you'll make it dynamic later.
Instead, let's focus on adding some more features to our entry card.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
